reporting-org.narrative: Royal Society of Tropical Medicine & Hygiene

description.narrative:
The Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene (RSTMH) early career grant programme enables early career researchers and global health professionals in the field of tropical medicine or global health to undertake clinical or scientific research or fieldwork, as stand alone projects or distinct elements within a larger project.
The 2022 Early Career Grants Programme will: - enable early career researchers and global health professionals in LMICs to undertake clinical and applied health research or fieldwork - develop and improve the research and management skills of early career LMIC researchers through leading a small independent research project - help early career LMIC researchers to widen their networks within their institutions, countries and potentially globally and within their field of work - establish a peer cohort of awardees to increase collaboration and networking opportunities - enhance future funding opportunities of LMIC early career researchers - strengthen a beneficial scheme to ensure that a higher proportion of fundable applications receive funding than previous years
